title: National Single Window Project Officially Launched
author: NSW Team
excerpt: The National Single Window project was officially launched in Tirana, marking a significant milestone toward modernizing trade procedures in Albania.
content: The National Single Window (NSW) project was officially launched on January 15, 2025, at a ceremony held in Tirana, attended by senior representatives from the Ministry of Economy and Innovation, the National Agency for Information Society (NAIS/AKSHI), and key cross-border regulatory agencies. This project represents a transformative step toward the full digitalization of trade procedures in Albania.

The National Single Window will enable trade operators to submit all required documents and information for import, export, and transit through a single electronic entry point. The system is designed in compliance with UN/CEFACT Recommendation No. 33 and Article 10.4 of the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement.

The Ministry of Economy and Innovation, as the lead ministry, emphasized the importance of this project for improving the business climate and facilitating cross-border trade. Eight Cross-Border Regulatory Agencies (CBRAs) will participate in the initial implementation phase, ensuring a comprehensive approach to border management.

The project, financed through a 5.9 million USD loan from the World Bank/IBRD, will integrate with the existing ASYCUDA World system and will be operated by NAIS/AKSHI. Implementation will be overseen by an inter-ministerial steering committee to ensure effective coordination among all stakeholders.
The launch ceremony concluded with a shared vision for a more competitive Albania in international trade, where customs and regulatory procedures will be faster, more transparent, and fully digital.
